findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：部分產品已被關稅涵蓋，新增或提高關稅可能提高材料成本，漲價未必能完全抵銷而壓低毛利；2025 年約 27% 銷售來自美國以外客戶。
findings.excerpt: Some of our products are included in these tariffs. The imposition of new or increased tariffs, duties, border adjustment taxes, or other trade restrictions by the United States could also result in the adoption of new or increased tariffs or other trade restrictions by other countries.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：公司受 ITAR、OFAC、EAR 等進出口管制，曾對美國國務院、能源部、商務部、財政部提交自願揭露，至今未造成重大罰款或出口特權被拒。
findings.excerpt: To date, our voluntary disclosures have not resulted in a fine, penalty, or export privilege denial or restriction that has had a material adverse impact on our financial condition or ability to export.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：2026 年 5 月 Q1 簡報稱 Aerospace & Industrial 的營運效率與重組節省超過中國關稅衝擊；FY2026 銷售成長上調至 7%–8%。
findings.source: Curtiss-Wright Q1 2026 Earnings Conf Call Slides

findings.claim: 美國對中國核能出口許可暫緩，CW 有五件申請待 NRC 審理
findings.excerpt: The US government's decision to delay authorization for nuclear exports to China appears to heavily impact Curtiss-Wright, which has five applications pending before the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), including one explicitly covering reactor coolant pumps (RCPs) while at least some others involve equipment used in RCPs.

note: Energy Intelligence 2026-05 稱公司有五件對中國核能出口申請待 NRC 審理（未讀到頁面，未列為 finding）。未查到 2026 年 Entity List 針對 CW 的行動。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
